name: Cross-Modal Alignment Optimization Strategy
definition: A training strategy using a weighted loss function to align rendered semantic fields with distilled 2D feature maps while preserving geometric quality and preventing optimization instabilities.
summary: Cross-Modal Alignment Optimization Strategy aligns rendered semantic fields with 2D vision-language features using contrastive loss, distinguishing itself from standard 3D Gaussian Splatting by optimizing high-dimensional semantic embeddings alongside geometric parameters.
